title: One-shot launch reel — ember dark, pain to product

source.author: @robj3d3
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the SuperX launch reel; structure and pacing follow it. The original's growth numbers (creators, posts, impressions) are replaced with product facts, so the Claude Imagine version carries no invented metrics.

facts.stats: 5 image models (Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2.5, Seedream 4.5, Flux 2 Pro, Z-Image), 6 video models (H3 Max Turbo, Grok Imagine, Seedance 1.5 Pro, Seedance 2.0 Mini, Veo 3.1 Fast, Kling 2.5 Turbo), up to 4K images — per src/config/ai-pricing.ts on 2026-10-01
facts.grid: resolution and duration chips per model come from the same file
facts.gallery: featured card text and all thumbnails are the site's own gallery images and their published prompts

scenes: four kinetic words with a reply card whose copy counter ticks up
collapse to a line, ember ring, brand tile with sparks, wordmark with sheen
zoom into the tile, iris opens on a blurred wall of gallery cards
chat composer typing a prompt, result chip, headline
composer collapses into a block that lands in the model grid
model grid tilts into 3D, image-topped bars rise, feature badges orbit
zoom and flash into three counting facts, vortex out
notes: The brand tile is assets/brand-mark.png (the warm logo variant proposed with the site restyle). Swap the file to change the logo; model names in the grid are hard-coded in the script.
